notes.text: The sheet contains two upper drawings, a flag-indexed contravariant construction, two Sigma formulas with revisions, cofinal marginal diagrams, a V formula and lower diagram, and a slanted marginal parameter equality/inequality. No theorem verification has been performed by this reader. The line_count of 13 counts main prose/formula/object baselines, excluding figure labels, interlinear corrections and marginal material.

The live phrase is "foncteur contravariant par rapport aux drapeaux variables". The nearby cancelled word remains uncertain. Cofinality is stated only by the marginal word "cofinaux"; no unstated direction or universal property has been added.

The Sigma formulas use the strict range k<i or i<k<j. The later V formula visibly uses i<=k<j. This difference is retained, as is its unresolved star/prime exponent; the formulas are not regularized into one convention.

The lower top connector has a left hook and no head. The dashed diagonal branch starts from the right vertical edge and has no labelled destination object. Its annotation and the struck lower-edge annotation remain uncertain. No mathematical map is supplied to fill the missing destination.

The thin top S|5 and underlined lower 6 are transcribed as marginal marks, with hand unassigned. C treated the top mark as author foliation; that attribution is not established from this leaf. H final section heading is editorial, not ink on this page.

The bottom marginal formulas retain asymmetric subscript/prime placement as seen, rather than supplying symmetric indices. The operator reads Inf, not Sigma. The quantities are not defined on this leaf.

Crops P03 and P10 were initially viewed in an upside-down text orientation and read mentally; their saved files were then deterministically rotated 180 degrees without rereading. P14/P15 were displayed individually after a multi-image output omitted them. P06 was reopened only for the newly identified tuple sub-place. P16 completes the clipped lower extent of the rotated margin. The main-text Sigma_(i,j) at its right is not a marginal object. The relation array has only a right vertical cap; no left cap is supplied.
